indicator_contract: exact IPS v1 frozen preregistration; no parameter, score, threshold, stop, target or horizon changes
effect_retention_definition: holdout lift / development lift, using score>=65 target-before-stop rate minus all-executable-event rate
failure_policy: Any hard holdout gate failure rejects IPS v1. No holdout-driven retune or rescue. A changed rule requires a new descendant and this holdout becomes EXPOSED for that genealogy.
after_holdout_if_pass: Proceed to Supergate on already-exposed development+holdout diagnostics without opening 2023-2026 true-forward reserve for tuning.
